Inline: small black diamond '17' before 'objective' → {vset:17} (stub: '[Light Side] objective'). Caption 'Do, Or Do Not (V)' — NO uniqueness dot on the slip's caption although the printed card is •Do, Or Do Not (base_title keeps the •).
